примечание: Авторская иллюстрация для поста. Изображение не является скриншотом рендерера.
промпт_дословно:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Finished editorial cover image for a Russian developer's personal Telegram post about returning to a long-paused open-source project plantuml-rs and preparing it for production.
Primary request: Create a distinctive, beautifully typeset technology editorial poster: text source becoming a clean UML diagram, conveying a project brought into working shape.
Canvas: Landscape 3:2, ideally 1536 by 1024. Solid background, no transparency.
Scene/backdrop: Warm off-white paper with extremely subtle drafting-grid texture, lots of breathing room. A restrained technical print aesthetic, precise and human, with dark graphite and a few warm rust-orange accents.
Subject: A large central illustrative composition where a small PlantUML source sheet feeds into neatly aligned UML participant cards and lifelines. Source at the left, sequence diagram at the right, with one clear rust-orange transition arrow between them. The diagram is an editorial illustration, not a screenshot of the product. Thin precise graphite lines, just enough tactile depth and soft paper shadows to feel physical.
Composition: Strong hierarchy for mobile readability. Upper area holds the very large project name "plantuml-rs" in bold dark modern monospace. Below it is the smaller Russian subtitle "Из текста — в диаграммы". The source-to-diagram illustration fills the middle and lower two thirds. A small baseline at the bottom reads "Rust / WebAssembly / SVG". Use generous margins.
Exact readable code on the source sheet, four lines:
"@startuml"
"Alice -> Bob: Hello"
"Bob --> Alice: OK"
"@enduml"
Diagram correctness: Two equal participant cards labeled "Alice" and "Bob". Two vertical dashed lifelines descending from their centers. At the upper message row, a solid horizontal right-pointing arrow from Alice to Bob labeled "Hello". At the lower row, a dashed horizontal left-pointing arrow from Bob to Alice labeled "OK". Four small, balanced participant cards total: two heads and two feet. All labels crisp. No extra diagram branches.
Typography: Render every requested word exactly. In particular, "plantuml-rs" is lowercase with a hyphen, never "plantuml.rs". Subtitle Cyrillic must be correct.
Constraints: A real finished raster editorial artwork. Keep the cover mature, clear and understated. No invented product logo, mascot, stock-photo laptop, rockets, confetti, people, glowing circuitry, neon, purple gradients, excessive 3D, fake badges, benchmark numbers, release version numbers, or extra copy. No claims of 100% compatibility. No watermark.

проверка_фактов.замер_C4: 87 секунд → 305 мс согласно CHANGELOG.md; повторный бенчмарк при подготовке поста не запускался.

Playground.решение: В посте дана ссылка на GitHub; завершённый публичный деплой не заявлен.

проверка_фактов.совместимость: Полная совместимость с PlantUML не заявлена.
